facts.text: Jolene visited an old temple and described the stairs as amazing.

evidence.quote: We had a great time visiting an old temple. The stairs were amazing!

facts.text: Deborah mentioned that she was in Rio de Janeiro three years prior and took a photo of a large stone structure with a mountain in the background.

evidence.quote: Three years ago I was also in Rio de Janeiro, I took a beautiful photo on one of the excursions.
I took a beautiful photo on one of the excursions. [image: a photo of a large stone structure with a mountain in the background]

facts.text: Deborah shared a photo of a hand holding a piece of paper with writing on it, which she described as a quote from a friend who will never be able to support her.

evidence.quote: I want to share this photo with you. [image: a photo of a hand holding a piece of paper with writing on it]
This was written to me by a friend who, unfortunately, will never be able to support me.

facts.text: The quote on the paper was 'Let go of what no longer serves you.'

evidence.quote: This quote says 'Let go of what no longer serves you.'
